spec.label_definition: UCR Beef five class codes 1-5; semantic code mapping not supplied
spec.license: Unverified; local exploratory use only until archive reuse terms confirmed
caveats: Supplied archive has 60 spectra, 470 points, five classes; paper also discusses 180 spectra across cooking levels.
Archive spectra are already per-spectrum z-normalized (sample SD approximately 1); raw absorbance cannot be reconstructed.
No physical IDs or wavelength axis supplied; preserve fixed official Train/Test, do not invent wavelength coordinates or class-code meanings.
PLS score count chosen using Validation only; this is a project holdout protocol, not the paper's leave-one-out evaluation.
